learning_outcomes.text: Understand the basic principles of the electrochemical biosensor, have knowledge about different application areas, biosensor preparation and how to extract the current response in electrochemical biosensors.
Have the ability to communicate in writing and verbally with the assigned homework and/or project reports and presentations.
To be able to follow the latest developments in biosensors and to be informed about the basics and application areas of biosensors.

syllabus_topics: Main components of biosensors, performance characteristics
Electrochemical methods used for biosensors, Midterm1
bibliography: Zhang, X., Ju, H., & Wang, J. (Eds.). (2011). Electrochemical sensors, biosensors and their biomedical applications. Academic Press
Ensafi, A. A. (Ed.). (2019). Electrochemical biosensors. Elsevier.
Kalcher, K., Svancara, I., Metelka, R., Vytras, K., & Walcarius, A. (2006). Encyclopedia of sensors. ASP New York, 4, 283.
